description: Pull teammates' docs and show open handoffs at session start. Publish edits in the background when a turn ends.

hooks.command: command -v apl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'The apl CLI is not installed, so docs in .apl/ are unavailable. Tell the user to install it with: npm i -g @ghmeier/agent-plan (see https://github.com/ghmeier/agent-plan#install for other options)'; exit 0; }; apl hook session-start
command -v apl >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; apl hook stop >/dev/null
